scope: Domain ownership inventory. Paired sources are not proof of shared behavior or rendered parity.

mechanics.name: World simulation and sky calendar
mechanics.note: Same world source; render adapters still host-owned.

mechanics.name: Base construction and upgrades
mechanics.note: Fixed-site placement and underground rooms; compare unlocks and costs before migration.

mechanics.name: Contracts, Free Ops and mission lifecycle
mechanics.note: Canonical mission state and optional client contracts; no editor-only mission store.

mechanics.name: Rocket assembly and loadout
mechanics.note: Purchasing, fitting and launch stay behind existing state transitions. Shared prefab geometry is consumed on both hosts.

mechanics.name: Flight and return-leg transitions
mechanics.note: Physical travel, separate from transit photometry. Use persisted timestamps.

mechanics.name: Landing and redocking
mechanics.note: Native landing route currently renders MiningScreen, not the web landing sequence.

mechanics.name: Laser mining, charges and cargo
mechanics.note: Canonical ship laser; not the rover or field engine.

mechanics.name: Delivery unloading and home cargo settlement
mechanics.note: Separate destination unload, return leg and home cargo allocation. Settlement must be idempotent.

mechanics.name: Market, daily economy and refinery jobs
mechanics.note: Refinery has native domain code but no native route or screen. Daily economy needs command-trace comparison.

mechanics.name: Skills, licences and XP
mechanics.note: XP source and native progression differ in granularity; source mapping is not behavior parity.

mechanics.name: Optional flight-plan training
mechanics.note: Training does not gate Free Ops. Replay rewards use the same completion transitions.

mechanics.name: Academy, staff and crew
mechanics.note: Roster and training ownership. Crew never increases citizen-science yield.

mechanics.name: Off-world sites, construction and ferries
mechanics.note: Native settlement logistics exists; embedded field factory and biosphere commands need separate adapters.

mechanics.name: Field refinery pipeline
mechanics.note: No equivalent native field refinery adapter identified; base Refinery is a different mechanic.

mechanics.name: Ownership transfers
mechanics.note: No equivalent native transfer domain identified.

mechanics.name: Site purchases and leases
mechanics.note: Native SurfaceOps site access is not the full lease/deed model.

mechanics.name: Treasury ledger, science rewards and loans
mechanics.note: No equivalent native treasury ledger or loan implementation identified.

mechanics.name: Field sandbox rules
mechanics.note: Do not confuse field sandbox domain rules with Studio preview presets.

mechanics.name: Instrument feed and survey scans
mechanics.note: Instrument state and feed navigation; no fictional citizen-science mission wrapper.

mechanics.name: Transit photometry classification
mechanics.note: Real light curves and verdicts; independent of spacecraft Transit.

mechanics.name: Asteroid candidate review
mechanics.note: Observation frames and classifications.

mechanics.name: Saturn storm review
mechanics.note: Storm annotations and classifications.

mechanics.name: Mission history and narrative ledger
mechanics.note: Read canonical records; do not create a parallel editor save.

mechanics.name: Offline-first game state and outbox
mechanics.note: Host service, not a scene object. All changes use canonical save/outbox paths.
